concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-marketplace-guide-confirmation-node]] - Node.js route for the post-verification approval-or-decline webhook confirmation step, returned account-state examples, validation-error navigation, and follow-up boundary; not account-creation, complete-onboarding, or current-availability proof.
warnings: Keep this guide distinct from the separate webhook event-kind and payload reference, and do not recast the notification as the operation that creates or decides the merchant account.

Preserve the after-third-party-verification trigger and approved-versus-declined state boundary; do not infer complete onboarding, funding readiness, transaction acceptance, decision timing, current Marketplace support, or merchant eligibility from this collected snapshot.

The collected approval snippet parses into `webhookNotification` but its final master-merchant status access uses `notification`; do not silently normalize or rely on that final variable access without separate authority.
